Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc

profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY. Its website describes the company as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence. The site highlights GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model, and Solaris, described as a first Interface World Model that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame without code. It also promotes a Runway AI Summit on 9/30 in San Francisco with speakers from DeepMind, NVIDIA and Physical Intelligence.

The company's tracked product is Runway, a video generation and editing offering. The site positions enterprise video generation as a focus, citing themes from enterprise conversations such as data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution and model ownership.

Runway is named in several lawsuits. These include David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Southern District of New York and the Central District of California, Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Southern District of New York, Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc in the Southern District of New York, and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. Runway is associated with 458 New York law exposure entries.
